usage.source_scope: Third prior-file-disjoint Commons batch with 20 images, four human-boxed actionable entrance views, 16 negatives, and six public target reference images.
usage.project_application: Replace scene-level identity AND entrance gating with candidate-specific target-to-entrance edges before tracking and guidance.
usage.modifications: Use expanded proposal context, a public target roster, harmonic entrance/identity edge evidence, set-valued ambiguity, and fail-closed search.
usage.expected_effect: Reject generic high-score doors belonging to a different nearby entity and, if proposal context carries enough identity, recover a correct unique target entrance.

evaluation.setup: One-shot zero-OCR Development comparison on a third source-disjoint 20-image batch. Entrance boxes were frozen before inference; CPU/GPU probes and device receipts were persisted.
evaluation.effect: GroundingDINO covered all four positive boxes. Target-local crop binding reduced false commits from 20 to 5 but made zero correct unique commits, so it is retained only as a safety filter and not as an entrance locator.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This supports a fail-closed false-commit filter and localizes the missing target-to-proposal evidence. It does not establish a correct entrance locator, public access, traversability, navigation, tracking, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Frozen V3 source inventory, exact human entrance boxes, unchanged reducer configuration, metrics, and one-shot stop rule.
V3 outcome, backend receipts, failure localization, next representation, and claim boundary.
